title: Your activity and report replies in one inbox
summary: Notifications now bring together sync results, coaching updates and replies from SC2 Tools.
highlights: Find the bell beside your account menu, even when Reviews are unavailable.
Filter the full inbox and choose which updates you receive.
Read replies to your reports in Settings → Help → My reports.

title: Check your PC before linking it
summary: Pairing shows the PC details before you confirm and waits for its first real connection.
highlights: Paste a pairing code or open the link from the desktop app.
Check the PC name and operating system before confirming.
Give devices a label and check their latest connection in Devices.

title: Stream controls recover without losing your draft
summary: The Stream Dock explains connection trouble and keeps unsaved controls ready for Retry.
highlights: See when a control is reconnecting or still loading.
Retry a failed save with your current form values.
Polls, goals and scene controls confirm successful saves.
